notes.title: Ghoul Smash - Winter's Bounty
notes.notes:
[h1]Winter Update[/h1]
A small update for the holiday season!
Ghoul Smash will be 25% off for the entire duration of Steam's Winter Sale. Happy holidays!
The game has been updated to v17.

[h2]Events[/h2]
[h3]Winter’s Bounty:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds 16 vanity equipment items.
[*] Adds 2 non-vanity equipment items.
[*] Introduces a new level filled with rewards and crafting materials. Fortune is useful for finding the new equipment.
[/list]

[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted and improved the graphics of the Interslice.
[*] Slightly adjusted the character model with more defined features, including the nose.
[*] Adjusted the character model's underwear to cover more.
[*] Adjusted the wounds displayed on the character model to appear slightly more visceral.
[/list]

[h2]New Status Effect[/h2]
[h3]Slow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduces an enemy's movement speed by 80%. This can be seen when they move or attack.
[*] Slow is removed at the end of the enemy's turn.
[/list]

Feel free to share your ideas for existing (or new) equipment that could make use of this effect.
Changes

notes.title: Ghoul Smash - v16
notes.notes:
[i]This update primarily focuses on quality of life improvements, with content taking a backseat. I am currently working on the Christmas Update, as well as continuing development for Act 3 and Atlas Invasions.[/i]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[h2]Steam Leaderboard[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to upload your statistics to a leaderboard. This can be done within the Statistics menu and will upload your stats alongside your Steam name.
[/list]
[h2]Mini-Bosses[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 1 new Mini-Boss to the Tangle Area in the Eternal Battleground.
[*] The boss drops 1 new versatile weapon.
[/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added rarity outlines to items and equipment.
[*] Redesigned a majority of the interface.
[*] Updated several descriptions within the in-game Guide.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[h2]Campaign[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Buff Plates to the Tomb Encounter to make it less punishing.
[/list]
[h2]Treasures Menu[/h2]
[h3]Item Filter[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed Auto-Salvage from this menu and replaced it with an Item Filter. The Item Filter will automatically salvage items below the selected Rarity. Rare Drop Table items and Unique items are whitelisted and will always drop, regardless of the filter setting.
[/list]

[h2]Speedboosts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a visual indicator showing the amount of Speedboosts remaining. Previously, this was hidden, causing some confusion.
[*] Slightly adjusted the Speedboosts granted by Skills to better fit the binary bar.
[/list]

[h1]Items & Equipment[/h1]
[h2]Astral Equipment[/h2]
[list]
[*] All items found with Astral Rarity will now have affixes of the highest tier possible.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[h3]Sharktooth Necklace[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the Rarity (Cosmetic).
[*] Now Unmodifiable.
[/list]
[i]Developer Note: Generally, I would prefer to avoid nerfing items. However, the power gained from the Blood Hunt Skill is significant enough to restrict the amulet. Alternatively, I could adjust the Skill itself, but I'll review feedback first.[/i]

[h2]Skills[/h2]
[h3]Chain Ball (Normal Flails)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now has 'magnetism' towards enemies. Every 0.6–1.2 seconds, a Chain Ball within range of an enemy will launch itself towards that enemy. This makes the skill more consistent at dealing damage.
[*] Now lasts until the start of your next turn. The knockback effect only triggers during your turn.
[*] Added new visuals.
[/list]

[h3]Cleave (Normal Axes)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the blood gibs to improve clarity.
[*] Increased the pull strength of the vortex.
[*] Massively increased the attack rate. It triggers the same number of attacks, but at a much faster rate.
[*] Old: 4 attacks over 1 second.
[*] New: 4 attacks over 0.4 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]Vortex (Legion)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the blood gibs to improve clarity.
[*] Increased the pull strength of the vortex.
[*] Massively increased the attack rate. It triggers the same number of attacks, but at a much faster rate.
[*] Old: 4 attacks over 1 second.
[*] New: 4 attacks over 0.4 seconds.
[*] Now spawns the additional axes at the location of the vortex, not the player's location.
[/list]

[h3]Bash (Normal Hammers)[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now use Jump Boosts to launch a Bash Projectile towards your cursor's location.
[*] You can now right-click to brake a Bash Projectile.
[/list]

[h3]
Explosive Bash (Boom Hammer)[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now use Jump Boosts to launch a Bash Projectile towards your cursor's location.
[*] You can now right-click to brake a Bash Projectile.
[/list]

[h3]Poison Slap (Ghoul Smasher)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now works as follows: When you collide with an enemy, you strike them 4 additional times, each strike having a 100% chance to poison and knock the enemy in a random direction.
[/list]

[h3]Avarice (Pharaoh's Crown)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now works as follows: Whenever you loot an item that is salvaged by the Item Filter, you gain +25 Bonus Fortune and a small Speedboost. Additionally, items salvaged by the Item Filter are salvaged at 10x their value.
[/list]

[h2]Statuses[/h2]
[h3]Poison[/h3]
[list]
[*] Poison has been bugged for some time. It is supposed to deal percentile damage when another poison proc is applied. This has now been fixed, alongside a slight buff.
[*] The first initial poison proc will now deal damage equal to 8–12% of the target's Constitution. Every additional poison application will deal damage equal to 1–3% of the target's Constitution. Poison is still applied at the start of an enemy's turn.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Cleave would trigger multiple Speedboosts on kill.
[*] Fixed a bug where bosses in the T4 Colosseum Atlas Core area would drop T6 items.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] When launching the game in Fullscreen mode, it sometimes creates a smaller window that is difficult to interact with.
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash - Update 15
notes.notes:
[h2]Pumpkin Smash[/h2]
Gather your gear and face off against the Pumpkin Creatures within the Eternal Battleground! Collect Candy and combine it with the Pumpkin Heart to create exciting new equipment. Pumpkin Smash is an event for October 2024 for Ghoul Smash.

While it is an event, it is [b]NOT[/b] time-limited, meaning it will always be available.

Features:
[list]
[*] 1x Armor Set (Helmet, Armor, Gloves, and Boots)
[*] 1x Weapon
[*] 1x Trinket
[*] A new way to modify encounters in the Eternal Battleground
[*] A new Atlas Core Encounter
[*] 3x New Enemies
[*] 1x New Boss
[/list]

[h2]Items & Equipment[/h2]
Added a new weapon type: Punchers
Punchers specialize in increasing the damage of your default collisions with no additional spirit cost. They are versatile, like wands, meaning you can wield them in your offhand.
There are a total of 6 puncher-type weapons added to the game in this update. You can acquire most from It That Bargains; however, the Tier 6 version must be found within the Eternal Battleground.

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted additional sounds with audio pitching and reduced the volume of more common sound effects.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Captain Blackbear'd wouldn't end his turn properly. For real, this time.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nexus Wand wouldn't launch a torrent of projectiles.
[*] Fixed a bug where boosters wouldn't trigger when you hit the boost limit. Boosters now always give a Speedboost.
[/list]

[h2]Thank you for supporting Ghoul Smash![/h2]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash v13
notes.notes:
[h1]General Balance[/h1]
The recent defense update, which reduced enemy damage, has improved combat stability in Ghoul Smash. To further benefit players, the pool of health is being increased.
[list]
[*] Players now gain +10 Constitution per level (previously 6).
[*] At level 50, this results in an additional 200 Constitution.
[/list]

[h1]Damage Affixes[/h1]
Hybrid affixes have been removed, but flat damage affixes have been significantly buffed.
Example: The Tier 6 affix "Ruinous" now grants 12 (previously 8) - 24 (previously 16) damage.

[h1]Atlas[/h1]
[h2]Crucible[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Atlas Fragment: Relic Chamber
[*] This Atlas Fragment is a puzzle map that will kill you on failure. It introduces five new items.
[/list]
[h3]Volcano[/h3]
[list]
[*] Molten Golem's total health has been reduced by 12.5%, from 2,000,000 to 1,750,000.
[/list]
[h3]Shadowfell[/h3]
[list]
[*] Raven Queen's total health has been reduced by 10%, from 1,000,000 to 900,000.
[/list]

[h1]Aetherflux[/h1]
[h2]Bloodletter[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now has the following effect: You take 20% less damage (after reductions) from enemies affected by Wound.
[/list]

[h1]It That Bargains[/h1]
[list]
[*] Visual effects have been slightly adjusted.
[*] Dialogue has been removed.
[*] The number of buying and selling slots has been increased to 12 (previously 5).
[*] Added a help tooltip.
[/list]

[h1]Sister of Concordance[/h1]
[list]
[*] The cost of an item has been reduced. It now costs between 10% - 30% (previously 40% - 90%) of current Salvage. The minimum cost remains 100,000 Salvage.
[/list]

[h1]Crafting[/h1]
[h2]Infused Whetstone[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increases a weapon's damage by 60% (previously 75%) and grants 12 to Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence (previously increased existing attributes by 75%).
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h2]Fury[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer has a 150% chance to launch a slicing wave when killing an enemy. It now correctly follows the intended 25% chance.
[/list]
[h2]Loadouts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Swapping loadouts while the vanity interface is open will no longer cause a crash.
[*] Swapping a loadout will now update skills properly.
[/list]

[h1]Saves[/h1]
Saves made before revision 11 will no longer be supported after this patch. Any save file that hasn't been launched since revision 11 will be deleted when revision 14 is released, due to the removal of legacy code.

notes.title: Ghoul Smash v12 - Defense Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Story[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Events with the Envoy.
[*] Added Events with Sisters of Concordance.
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new achievement.
[/list]

[h1]Save Slots[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added save slots.
[/list]

[h1]Defense Rework[/h1]
[h2]Damage Reduction[/h2]
[list]
[*] Maximum Damage Reduction is now capped at 80% baseline.
[*] Maximum Damage Reduction can be increased to a maximum of 96%.
[*] Reduced the values of Damage Reduction on Affixes.
[*] Almost every item with Damage Reduction has been adjusted.
[*] Adjusted Barricade Keystone.
[/list]
[h2]Dodge[/h2]
[list]
[*] Maximum Dodge is now 80% baseline.
[*] Maximum Dodge is capped at 96%.
[*] Reduced the values of Dodge on Affixes.
[*] Almost every item with Dodge has been adjusted.
[*] Adjusted Windrunner Keystone.
[/list]
[h2]Glancing Hits[/h2]
Dodge has very much been a live or die situation; and requires a secondary defense to even be viable. To help alleviate this issue, Glancing Hits have been added.
When you fail to Dodge an attack, the attacker's attack roll will be unluckily rolled against your Dodge Chance. If your Dodge Chance now beats the new attacker unlucky roll, damage received will be halved as a glancing hit. This will apply before Damage Reduction.
[h2]Barrier[/h2]
[h3]Barrier Regeneration[/h3]
[list]
[*] Base Barrier Regeneration is now 10%.
[*] Maximum Barrier Regeneration is 100%.
[*] Every 5 Intelligence grants 1% Barrier Regeneration.
[*] Adjusted Weaveborn Keystone.
[/list]
[h1]Combat[/h1]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] All enemies now deal 30% less Damage.
[*] All enemies have 30% more Constitution.
[/list]
[h2]Mini Bosses[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer guarantee a Rare Drop Table drop.
[*] Can now be toggled on or off after getting the upgrade.
[/list]
[h2]Eternal Battleground[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy scaling in each tier has been reduced significantly.
[/list]
[h2]Buff Plates[/h2]
[list]
[*] They now trigger when you slide over them, like boost plates.
[*] Effects have been reduced.
[*] They can only activate once per round.
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Text now pops a bit more during combat
[/list]
[h1]Interslice[/h1]
[h2]Urwood[/h2]
[list]
[*] Max Level Upgrade has been removed. This will be added back at a later point for Act 3.
[*] Character who have purchased this upgrade will retain it.
[/list]
[h2]Aetherflux[/h2]
[list]
[*] The cost of Skill Points has increased SIGNIFICANTLY
[*] An in-game method has been added to help alleviate this.
[/list]
[h2]Storage[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Loadout Slots
[*] You gain an additional loadout slot every 2 upgrades.
[/list]
[h2]Panel[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the Vanity Menu to replace the transmog menu,
[/list]
[h1]Items & Equipment[/h1]
[h2]Parrying Daggers[/h2]
[h3]Parry[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now grants a flat +20% Dodge and -20% Damage Reduction.
[/list]
[h3]Riposte[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now grants a flat +20% Dodge and -20% Damage Reduction.
[/list]
[h3]Serrated Parry[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now grants a flat +20% Dodge and -20% Damage Reduction.
[/list]
[h2]Swords[/h2]
[h3]Stab[/h3]
[list]
[*] On kill, you have a 25% (Previously 100%) chance to launch a slicing wave towards the nearest enemy that has a 100% chance to Wound.
[/list]
[h3]Vampiric Stab[/h3]
[list]
[*] On kill, you have a 25% (Previously 100%) chance to launch a slicing wave towards the nearest enemy that has a 100% chance to Wound.
[/list]
[h3]Fury[/h3]
[list]
[*] On kill, you have a 25% (Previously 100%) chance to launch a slicing wave towards the nearest enemy that has a 100% chance to Wound.
[/list]
[h2]Lance[/h2]
[h3]Joust[/h3]
[list]
[*] While moving you gain a charge every 0.5 (previously 1) seconds up to 10 (Previously 5).
[*] Now Has:Gain 1 Jump Boost
[/list]
[h3]Charge Thrust[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now has: Gain 1 Jump Boost
[/list]
[h2]Mace[/h2]
[h3]Crush[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now deals the additional hit at the end of the launch.
[/list]
[h3]Divine Crush[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now deals the additional hit at the end of the launch.
[/list]
[h2]Affixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed the following affixes,
[*] Hybrid Dexterity & Strength
[*] Hybrid Strength & Intelligence
[*] Hybrid Intelligence & Dexterity
[*] Hybrid Pierce & Accuracy
[*] Hybrid Damage & Critical Chance
[*} Likely a temporary change, going to keep the simplicity for now.
[*] Buffed Constitution affixes.
[*] Buffed Spirit affixes.
[*] Buffed Barrier affixes.
[*] Nerfed Pierce affixes slightly.
[*] Nerfed Accuracy affixes slightly.
[*] Nerfed Damage Reduction affixes slightly.
[*] Nerfed Dodge affixes affixes slightly.
[/list]

notes.title: Play Ghoul Smash during the Steam Nextfest!
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam's Next Fest[/h1]
Ghoul Smash is participating in the Steam Next Fest until the 17th! Feel free to play and join the discord for more information. During this time, the Combat Tutorial will reward the Next Fest Medallion, an early game trinket.

[h1]Developmental Help[/h1]
Ghoul Smash is looking for Linux users and Steam Deck owners to begin testing on that platform soon.

Ghoul Smash is looking for translators to begin translating the game to more languages. You can do so yourself by editing the localization.csv file within the game directory.

[h1]Ghoul Smash v.11 r.6 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Urwood[/h2]
[h3]Upgrade Max Level[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new upgrade that increases the player's level cap to 100.
[*] This upgrade costs 2,000,000 Salvage.
[*] All experience earned at level 50 will be retroactively added once this upgrade is purchased.
[/list]

[h2]Demo[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the Demo to the Current Beta Version.
[*] Extended the length of the demo, going all the way to the Dungeon in Act 1.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where The Gamble wouldn't show up in the shop.
[/list]

[h1]Road Map[/h1]
While I plan to release Ghoul Smash into early access very soon, Act 3 will not be finished in this time frame. The next planned updates are as follows:
[list]
[*] Save Slots
[*] New Atlas Fragment Boss
[*] More Interactions During Combat
[*] Defense Rework
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash - Version 9
notes.notes:
In Preparation for the Steam NEXTFEST in June, Ghoul Smash has recieved some updates!

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[h2]Linux / Steam Deck[/h2]
[list]
[*] The first build with Linux support has been implemented.
[/list]

[h2]Save Backups[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ghoul Smash now includes a backups folder located in %appdata%/roaming/Ghoul_Smash. After each game session, a backup of your current save will be created, up to a maximum of 10 backups. The oldest backup will be automatically deleted if there are already 10 saved. Note that this folder will be removed during forced Save Wipes or upon player death in Hardcore mode.
[*] To load a backup, simply copy and paste your desired backup into the main /Ghoul_Smash/ folder and rename it to 'saveData.sav', overwriting any existing save data.
[/list]

[h2]Guide[/h2]
[list]
[*] The first iteration of an in-game guide has been introduced, and it will receive continual updates.
[/list]

[h2]Items & Equipment[/h2]
New Weapon Type: Maces
[list]
[*] 7 new weapons
[*] 2 new armor sets
[*] 3 new pairs of gloves
[/list]

[h3]Atlas Fragments[/h3]
A new area, The Hollows, has been added.

[h3]Crafting Materials[/h3]
[list]
[*] 1 new whetstone
[*] 3 new shards, sparks, and stars
[/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 new enemy types
[*] 1 new mini-boss
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added tooltips to various elements.
[*] Reworked the Attributes Window for improved readability and added additional information.
[*] Moved the Class Changing Buttons to the Aetherflux.
[*] Right-clicking now allows for points to be refunded in the Aetherflux.
[*] Right-clicking also enables quick unequipping and equipping of items when no other window is open.
[*] Reworked the Crafting Window and streamlined the dropping of materials to make crafting quicker and less cumbersome.
[*] Skill gems now provide information about the associated skill.
[/list]

[h2]Critical Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Critical Chance has been made harder to acquire, making the Celestial Barrage Keystone more unique.
[*] Affixes with Critical Chance have had their values halved.
[*] Most rings and equipment with Critical Chance have been reduced.
[/list]

[h2]Keystones[/h2]
[h3]Carnage[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now leech 0.25% (previously 2%) of your Skill Damage as Constitution.
[/list]

[h3]Astral Battery[/h3]
[list]
[*] You gain damage equal to 25% of your Spirit (previously 500% of your Spirit Cost).
[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] The maximum reduction in an enemy's Damage Reduction with Pierce is now capped at -10%.
[*] Enemies now have a maximum Dodge chance of 95%, ensuring a minimum 5% chance to hit them even if their Dodge chance exceeds 95%. Accuracy is still advantageous; however, to reduce their Dodge chance below 95%, a minimum of 46 Accuracy is required in the example provided.
[/list]

[h2]Skills[/h2]
[h3]Thrust[/h3]
[list]
[*] All variants of Thrust have been updated to reduce the minimum enemy damage reduction to -20% and now include Pierce as a built-in feature.
[/list]

[h3]Ball Lightning[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Ball Lightning should have summoned a maximum of 2 Lightning Orbs; now it correctly summons up to 3 Lightning Orbs.
[/list]

[h3]Energy Leech[/h3]
[list]
[*] 5% (previously 2%) of your Default Collision Damage is now leeched as Barrier.
[/list]

[h3]Energy Siphon[/h3]
[list]
[*] 0.1% (previously 0.5%) of your Skill Damage is now leeched as Barrier.
[/list]

[h3]Siegebolt[/h3]
Siegebolt outperformed many of the other T6 Weapons with no investment required. It has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Reduced the base damage to 40 (previously 60) of each projectile.
[*] Reduced the base damage of the Shrapnel to 30 (previously 60).
[/list]

[h3]Resonance[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now gain x0.25 (previously x0.5) Damage at the start of your turn if your Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence are equal.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Character Model appearing when in the Options Menu.
[*] Fixed the Molten Golem encounter from dropping Tier 1 Items.
[*] Fixed the Tooltip for Trident Dagger.
[*] Resolved an issue where selecting a resolution above your monitor's capabilities caused the cursor to lock, requiring manual adjustment of the resolution via systemdata.ini in %appdata%/roaming/Ghoul_Smash.
[*] Fixed a soft lock that occurred when attempting to open the Attributes Window while selecting mode at the beginning of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash v0.8.1.0 - Demo Expansion & More
notes.notes:
[h1]Ghoul Smash v0.8.1.0[/h1]
This update features a plethora of changes featuring smoother combat, item rarities, new art, and effects, and more! This update will forcefully delete your existing save to ensure no crashes happen. Expect more save wipes whilst the game is in development.

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[h2]Demo Expansion[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Demo Version of the game is now 4 levels longer, allowing you to play around with Tier 3 items and equipment!
[/list]
[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] The UI has been changed significantly, much better than before!
[/list]
[h2]Equipment[/h2]
[list]
[*] 30 New Items and Equipment added, alongside new skills and combinations.
[/list]
[h2]Crafting Materials[/h2]
[list]
[*] Confluence Orb – Rerolls an Item guaranteeing it to be at least Magic rarity.
[*] Gold Confluence Orb – Rerolls an Item guaranteeing it to be at least Rare rarity.
[*] Astral Confluence Orb – Rerolls an Item guaranteeing it to be at least Astral rarity with high-tier Affixes.
[*] Augment Orb – Upgrades a Magic item to Rare adding an additional Affix.
[*] Gold Augment Orb - Upgrades a Magic item to Rare adding an additional high-tier Affix.
[*] Awakening Orb – Upgrades a Rare item to Astral adding an additional high-tier Affix.
[/list]
[h2]Player Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Small Combat Player appearance changes now depending on the items and equipment you’re wearing. Similarly to the large player model.
[/list]
[h2]Equipment Changes[/h2]
Infused Equipment
[list]
[*] Equipment now has a chance to drop at different rarities: Magic, Rare, Astral, and Legendary.
[*] An item can only have one affix of each type on it. (No duplicated affixes)
[*] Magic Equipment has 1 Affix.
[*] Rare Equipment has 2 Affixes.
[*] Astral Equipment has 3 Affixes.
[*] Legendary Equipment has 4 Affixes.
[/list]
[h2]Combat Changes[/h2]
[h3]Density[/h3]
Enemies are now much less dense resulting in less directional changes and slowdowns.
Enemies now have much more friction sliding around significantly less.
Larger Enemies like the Skeletal Golem are unaffected by the Density change and remain dense.
[h3]Infused Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Depending on Enemy Tier, non-boss enemies can now become either Magic, Rare, or Astral infused.
[*] Infused Enemies have a higher chance of dropping additional crafting materials depending on their infusion.
[*] Magic Enemies have 50% more Constitution, and Damage. Magic Enemies have +5% more base Drop Chance and drop 1 additional item.
[*] Rare Enemies have 100% more Constitution, and Damage. Rare Enemies have +10% more base Drop Chance and drop 2 additional items.
[*] Astral Enemies have 300% more Constitution and Damage. Astral Enemies have +15% more base Drop Chance and drop 3 additional items.
[/list]

[h2]Atlas[/h2]
[h3]The Eternal Battleground[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now has more detailed information regarding difficulty scaling.
[*] Removed the infinitely increasing Atlas Tier system. Replaced with 16 Tiers each with their own set difficulty.
[*] The Urwood now has an upgrade to add mini bosses to your area. Each mini boss has a unique drop and guarantees a reward on the Rare Drop Table.
[/list]
[h3]Crucible[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new encounter has been added – Shadowfell
[*] Each existing encounter has been adjusted to function similarly to Atlas Tiers within the Eternal Battleground. Currently I believe many of the encounters to be over tuned, beware!
[/list]
[h2]Enemy Loot[/h2]
[h3]Normal Loot[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies no longer drop Shards, Sparks, or Stars
[*] The Amount of Crafting Materials dropped by enemies globally has increased by significantly.
[/list]
[h3]Rare Drop Table[/h3]
[list]
[*] Charms have been removed.
[*] Tier 0 Enemies no longer have a chance to roll the RDT.
[*] Base chance to roll on the RDT is now 1 in 20,000 (Previously 1 in 5,000) and the effectiveness of Fortune has been reduced.
[/list]
[h3]Essence Forge[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Tier 1, 2, and 3 Material rewards have been changed to the Shard, Spark, and Star rewards respectively.
[*] Essence is now a built-in currency that functions similarly to Salvage.
[*] Skills
[*] Almost every skill has been looked at an adjusted slightly. The list is too long, sorry!
[/list]
[h2]Additional Notes[/h2]
Unfortunately, I was poor at tabbing out and noting down each additional change. This list fails to encapsulate everything as there are a lot more changes not on this list. Hopefully I will simply be better in the future.

notes.title: Ghoul Smash Demo
notes.notes:
The Ghoul Smash Demo is now available to play! Alongside this demo comes some new features added to the hub.

[h1]Demo[/h1]
The Ghoul Smash Demo allows you to play up to the Bone Golem boss in Act 1, access tier 2 Items and Equipment, Rare-drop Table, Three Classes and Tier 1 of the Essence Forge.
The demo will receive minor updates and changes that happen to the main game. If you want to enjoy the game on full-release please wish list and join the discord to get updates on Ghoul Smash Development.

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[h2]Ranger[/h2]
[h3]Windrunner Keystone[/h3]
[list]
[*] Your Damage is increased by 100% of your Speed.
[*] Your Pierce is increased by 50% of your Speed.
[*] You can gain twice the amount of Speedboosts per turn.
[*] When you Dodge, you restore Constitution equal to twice your Dexterity and gain 20% Damage Reduction until the beginning of the next round. (Does not stack)
[/list]

[h2]Hub[/h2]
[h3]Lost Treasures[/h3]
The Urwood now has an update that allows you to have a treasure box inside the hub. The treasure box functions similarly to the loot menu except you can access it at any time.
You have two toggleable options that allow you to automatically skip the loot screen and automatically salvage items.

[h3]Transmogrification[/h3]
You can now upgrade the Crafting Bench to transmogrify your items. This feature is still in development and will likely be modified in the future.

[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemies have been given more friction to make them less bouncy.
[*] Adjusted the density of the Player, making them by default 33% more dense.
[*] Adjusted the scaling of Speed when launching. It is more consistent the denser the player is.
[*] Adjusted the amount of density the player gains at higher Damage Reduction values.
[/list]

[*]Fixed a bug where Burning Men would keep burning the player on collision. (The burn is supposed to only trigger once per round).
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the prices of Urwood Upgrades.
[*] Altered the scaling of enemies in the Eternal Battleground; they now deal less damage but have increased constitution.
[*] Atlas Maps are now slightly more rare.
[*] Changed the sprite for Atlas Fragments
[*] Barrier gained from Barrier Shards, Sparks, and Stars has been doubled.
[*] Barrier gained from Affixes has been doubled.
[*] Barrier on Equipment has been increased.
[*] Base droprate of Eternal Battleground Enemies has been increased.
[*] Base Salvage reward of Eternal Battleground encounters has been increased significantly.
[*] Salvage reward from Eternal Battleground encounters now scales with Atlas Tier.
[/list]

[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Flintlock Pistol now scales with Finesse.
[/list]

[h3]Cleave[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the speed boost on kill to 0.25 (previously 0.75).
[/list]

[h3]Chain Ball[/h3]
[list]
[*] Decreased the scaling to B (previously A).
[*] Reduced the speed boost on kill to 0.15 (previously 0.25).
[/list]

[h3]Arrow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the scaling for all bow skills to A (previously B).
[/list]

[h3]Lion Spine[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now accurately matches its tooltip.
[/list]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tier 3 Crafting Materials now drop from Tier 5 enemies.
[*] Added 3 new Trinkets.
[*] The maximum Eternal Battleground Tier is now 50 (Tier 6 begins at 50+ and will continue endlessly).
[*] The Bone Gauntlet has been introduced as an Atlas Fragment Drop.
[*] The Bone Gauntlet is a challenging 8-wave encounter that can challenge highly geared players. Beware in Hardcore mode.
[*] The Bone Gauntlet features 2 new items and skills.
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash Patch Notes v0.7.8.6
notes.notes:
[h1][b]User Interface[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some Strings and typos with items, equipment, tooltips, and descriptions.
[*] You can now transfer things with Right Click into and out of the Atlas Crucible.
[/list]

[h1][b]Combat[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now change equipment during combat. (Surely this won't have any bugs....)
[*] Trinket Skills now function properly.
[*] Mimic Rare Drop is now significantly less rare (1% -> 25%)
[*] Fixed a bug where Skill Damage would appear where the skill is currently located and not where the target is located.
[*] The Rat King's animation speed is now fixed.
[/list]

[h1][b]Skills[/b][/h1]
[h2]Cleave[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scaling is now A (Previously S)
[*] Cleave now summons a swirling vortex that deals damage to enemies inside, launching them if they survive. Enemies killed by the vortex give a Speedboost.
[/list]

[h2]Thrust[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gives a Speedboost every time the spear stabs.
[*] The Speedboost amount has been increased (+40%)
[*] Spears attack faster (+20%)
[*] Spears have more range (+30%)
[/list]

[h2]Bash[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reverted the Knockback effect to the old method to make it not go straight horizontal and vertical so often.
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Deity Fruit now costs more in the shop.
[*] Jury now has more damage.
[*] Styx now has more damage.
[*] Confluence Orbs now work on Rings and Necklaces.
[*] A new item called the Catalyst has been added to the drop pool at Tier 5. The Catalyst will upgrade an item's Tier to 5.
[/list]
